item.tib: theg rim gyi rnam bshad gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: theg pa rim pa gsal byed me long zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa/ kha ba can gyi shar phyogs rgya (rgyal) mo rong du skyes pa'i/ sga ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la/ dbra ston bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bskul zhing / rtags bsdus gzhigs gnas ri khrod du sbyar ba'o//
